svg.title: Reverse lunge, side view
svg.desc: Side view of a figure with hands on the hips doing a reverse lunge: one foot steps back and lands on the ball of the foot, the hips go straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor and both knees are bent to about a right angle with the torso upright, then the figure pushes through the front foot and the back foot swings forward to stand tall again.
